name: android-credential-issuer
description: Issue digital credentials to user holder wallets from an Android issuer app over OpenID4VCI using Jetpack Credential Manager and hardware-backed Android Keystore attestation. Use this skill when building an Android credential issuer app, provisioning credentials to wallets with CreateDigitalCredentialRequest and CredentialManager.createCredential, constructing OpenID4VCI (openid4vci-v1) credential offer JSON payloads, or configuring and validating android_keystore_attestation certificate chains and c_nonce challenges. Don't use for holder wallet registration (RegistryManager), requesting credentials as a verifier (GetDigitalCredentialOption), passkeys, or carrier TS.43 phone number verification.
